newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EMERSON SET FOR COMEBACK DESPITE MORE PROBLEMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EMERSON SET FOR COMEBACK DESPITE MORE PROBLEMS.

text.p: Brazilian midfielder Emerson is set for his comeback match with Middlesbrough despite making his second delayed return to the English premier league club this month.

Middlesbrough manager Bryan Robson is to fine Emerson for reporting back late for training after a weekend break in Portugal, but still has the South American in line for a League Cup fourth-round home tie against Newcastle on Wednesday.
Robson allowed Emerson to fly to Portugal to "sort out some problems", but the Brazilian missed his return flight on Monday and did not arrive back in Middlesbrough until Tuesday.
Emerson's latest show of defiance has clearly tested Robson's patience to the limits, but the Boro boss is convinced the Brazilian is in the right frame of mind to face Newcastle.
"I am sure Emerson will be focused on the game," said Robson. "I don't think there is a problem over that and I am convinced the fans will give him a tremendous reception."

Emerson caused consternation at the club when he went home to Brazil for a holiday in the wake of Middlesbrough's 3-1 premier league defeat at Newcastle at the beginning of this month, vowing not to return because of his wife's homesickness.

But with Boro threatening to ask FIFA to impose a worldwide ban on Emerson, signed for the start of the season in a four million pounds sterling ($6.7 million) deal, the midfielder reluctantly flew back to England.
Now Robson is hoping Emerson, who is serving a three-match league ban but is eligible for the League Cup, can pick up where he left off and lay the foundations for a badly-needed victory.
